## Checklist

**This repository is public.** It is on GitHub Free, so nothing blocks a merge automatically. These boxes are the guardrail.

- [ ] `make ci` is green locally (actionlint, html-validate, content guard) and the `ci` check is green on this PR
- [ ] No server addresses, internal IPs, account names, invitation links, setup keys, passwords, tokens or private keys anywhere in the diff
- [ ] Pages still work without JavaScript where they did before
- [ ] Squash-merge and delete the branch afterwards
